t: You're on Victoria Grove, a street in Kensington, in the W8 postcode. Houses here began going up in 1837 and were finished in 1841. That start date is no accident of timing worth overlooking, because 1837 is the year Queen Victoria came to the throne, and the street carries her name. She reigned until 1901, longer than any monarch before her, and her sixty-three years gave their name to the Victorian era.
